title: Log stream delivery is failing
description: Notifies when a log stream reports failed delivery attempts to its destination.

definition.name: [Akamai Cloud Pulse] Log stream {{entity_label.name}} has failed deliveries
definition.message:
Log stream `{{entity_label.name}}` had {{value}} failed delivery attempts in the last 4 hours.

Check the destination (bucket or HTTPS endpoint), its credentials, and its permissions.
